note: 下列数值是约定起点，来自常见中文阅读习惯，或对已读编辑长文静帧的结构观察（刊头对比、发丝、左线引用）。它们不是从截图量得的实测，也不是实验室数据。实现可在给定范围内微调，但三种预设必须仍然显著不同。

allowed: 可随项目分发且许可明确的开源字体，例如 SIL OFL 的 Noto Sans SC、Noto Serif SC；思源系列仅在已具备相应许可并且确实分发时写入
forbidden: 用免费字体假冒某版权字体名称
在说明里宣称使用了并未捆绑或并未许可的字体

optionalControls.copyCopies: frozen article text, not CSS and not the skill body

typographies.name: 长文阅读
typographies.fontFamily: "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Songti SC", "STSong", "SimSun", "Georgia", serif
typographies.canvas: quiet near-paper or near-white, not a workbench card wall
typographies.maxMeasure: 32-40 han characters, or 36rem, whichever is shorter
typographies.quote: left rule, slightly increased padding, same size or slightly smaller, line-height at least body

typographies.name: 编辑杂志
typographies.fontFamily: display and body may use the same serif stack; kicker may use tracked sans
typographies.fontFamilyBody: "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Songti SC", "STSong", "SimSun", "Georgia", serif
typographies.maxMeasure: 30-36 han characters, or 34rem, whichever is shorter
typographies.quote: required left rule and clear padding
typographies.kicker: optional interface label 示例文稿 only, do not add article sentences
typographies.evidence: Structure borrows from already-read editorial stills; do not copy their article or photography.

typographies.name: 紧凑知识笔记
typographies.fontFamily: "Noto Sans SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
typographies.canvas: near-white or faint gray, not a decorative magazine sheet
typographies.maxMeasure: 40-48 han characters, or 28-32rem, whichever is shorter; never full-bleed on ultrawide
typographies.quote: compact callout with left rule or light fill, not an enlarged magazine pull quote
typographies.inlineLatin: sans or monospace, still unbreakable inside the token
